name: whatsync
description: Use your WhatsApp from the terminal: read chats, search messages and send, from you or your AI agent.

scripts.build: bun build src/index.ts --target=node --banner='#!/usr/bin/env node' --outfile=dist/whatsync.js && chmod +x dist/whatsync.js
scripts.prepublishOnly: bun run typecheck && bun run test && bun run build
